value.value: Facility is unsecured/unguaranteed initially; springing guarantees and collateral triggered only upon a Domestic Restricted Subsidiary incurring Subsidiary Debt requiring a Guarantee (Section 6.01) or a Collateral Trigger Event requiring a Lien on Principal Property (Section 6.02). Guarantees on unsecured unsubordinated basis; collateral is pari passu security interest in Principal Property subject to an Initial Lien.
value.note: verbatim: “If any Domestic Restricted Subsidiary is required to Guarantee the Obligations pursuant to Section 6.01, then the Borrower shall (i) ... cause such Domestic Restricted Subsidiary to enter into a Guaranty ... If the Borrower or any Domestic Restricted Subsidiary is required to grant a Lien on any Principal Property to secure the Obligations pursuant to Section 6.02 (a "Collateral Trigger Event"), then the Borrower shall ... grant to the Administrative Agent ... a valid pari passu security interest”

value.value: Mandatory prepayment: (Section 2.08(c)) if Aggregate Total Exposure exceeds total Commitments; (Section 2.08(d)) upon termination following a Change of Control Triggering Event. Events of Default (Section 7.01): (a) failure to pay principal; (b) failure to pay interest/fees unremedied 5 Business Days; (c) incorrect representation/warranty; (d) breach of specified covenants; (e) other covenant breach unremedied 30 days; (f) cross-default on Material Indebtedness (>$250,000,000); (g) cross-acceleration; (h)-(j) bankruptcy/insolvency events; (k) judgments >$250,000,000; (l) ERISA Events; (m) Loan Document invalidity.
value.note: verbatim: “If at any time the Aggregate Total Exposure exceeds the total Commitments then in effect, the Borrower shall promptly prepay the Revolving Loans to the extent necessary so that the Aggregate Total Exposure shall not exceed the Commitments then in effect.”

value.value: Senior Unsecured facility (titled “SENIOR UNSECURED REVOLVING CREDIT AGREEMENT”); no collateral or guarantors stated. Negative pledge under Section 6.01 with equal-and-ratable sharing; Cash Collateral provisions apply only to L/C Obligations/Defaulting Lenders
value.note: verbatim: “SENIOR UNSECURED REVOLVING CREDIT AGREEMENT ... The Borrower will not, and will not permit any of its Domestic Restricted Subsidiaries, to enter into, create, incur or assume any Lien on any Principal Property ... in order to secure any Indebtedness (the “ Initial Lien ”), without effectively providing that the Obligations shall be equally and ratably secured”

value.value: Mandatory prepayment (Section 2.08(c)): if Aggregate Total Exposure exceeds total Revolving Commitments, the Borrower shall promptly prepay to eliminate the excess. Events of Default (Section 7.01): (a) failure to pay principal; (b) failure to pay interest/fees/other amounts (5 Business Day grace); (c) incorrect representation/warranty in material respect; (d) breach of Section 5.02, 5.03 (existence), 5.07 or Article 6; (e) breach of other covenants (30-day cure); (f) failure to pay principal >$250,000,000 of Material Indebtedness; (g) Material Indebtedness acceleration events; (h) involuntary bankruptcy (60 days); (i) voluntary bankruptcy; (j) inability to pay debts; (k) judgments >$250,000,000 (60 days); (l) ERISA Events; (m) Loan Document ceases to be in full force; (n) Change of Control Triggering Event
value.note: verbatim: “(c) If at any time the Aggregate Total Exposure exceeds the total Revolving Commitments then in effect, the Borrower shall promptly prepay the Revolving Loans to the extent necessary so that the Aggregate Total Exposure shall not exceed the Revolving Commitments then in effect.”

value.value: No traditional financial-maintenance covenant (e.g., leverage/interest coverage tested quarterly). An Aggregate Debt basket incorporating a leverage measure appears in the negative covenants (Sections 6.01(b), 6.02(b), 6.04(b)): Aggregate Debt not to exceed the greater of (a) $3,750,000,000 (amended from $2,500,000,000) and (b) 2.75 times Consolidated EBITDA (amended from 2.50 times) for the Measurement Period immediately preceding incurrence.
value.note: verbatim: “any Domestic Restricted Subsidiary may create, incur, issue or assume Subsidiary Debt ... if after giving effect thereto, Aggregate Debt does not exceed an amount equal to the greater of (a) $ 2,500,000,000 , 3,750,000,000, and (b) 2.50 2.75 times Consolidated EBITDA of the Borrower for the Measurement Period immediately preceding the date of the creation or incurrence of the Subsidiary Debt.”

value.value: Facility is unsecured/no pledged collateral at closing; guarantees and collateral arise only on trigger events. Section 6.01(a): Domestic Restricted Subsidiaries incurring Subsidiary Debt must Guarantee the Obligations on an unsecured unsubordinated basis (via Guaranty, Exhibit E). Section 6.02(a) (Liens): if Borrower/Domestic Restricted Subsidiary grants an Initial Lien on Principal Property to secure Indebtedness, the Obligations must be equally and ratably secured. Section 5.10 (Guarantors; Collateral) governs delivery of Guaranty and grant of pari passu security interest upon Collateral Trigger Event. "Guarantor" means any Subsidiary of the Borrower that has delivered a Guaranty.
value.note: verbatim: “If any Domestic Restricted Subsidiary is required to Guarantee the Obligations pursuant to Section 6.01 , then the Borrower shall (i) concurrently with the incurrence of the Subsidiary Debt triggering such requirement, cause such Domestic Restricted Subsidiary to enter into a Guaranty ... The Borrower will not permit any of its Domestic Restricted Subsidiaries to create, assume, incur, Guarantee or otherwise become liable for any Indebtedness ..., without Guaranteeing the payment of the Obligations on an unsecured unsubordinated basis”

value.value: Mandatory prepayment (Section 2.08(c)): if Aggregate Total Exposure exceeds total Commitments, Borrower shall promptly prepay to eliminate the excess; Section 2.08(d) prepayment upon Change of Control Triggering Event commitment termination. Events of Default (Section 7.01) include: (a) failure to pay principal; (b) failure to pay interest/fees unremedied for 5 Business Days; (c) material misrepresentation; (d)/(e) covenant breaches (30-day cure for (e)); (f) failure to pay Material Indebtedness (>$250,000,000); (g) cross-acceleration of Material Indebtedness; (h)/(i)/(j) bankruptcy/insolvency; (k) judgments in excess of $250,000,000; (l) ERISA Events; (m) Loan Document ceasing to be in effect. Remedies: terminate Commitments and accelerate Loans (automatic upon bankruptcy events).
value.note: verbatim: “If at any time the Aggregate Total Exposure exceeds the total Commitments then in effect, the Borrower shall promptly prepay the Revolving Loans to the extent necessary so that the Aggregate Total Exposure shall not exceed the Commitments then in effect. ... Section 7.01 Events of Default. If any of the following events (each, an “ Event of Default ”) shall occur: (a) the Borrower shall fail to pay any principal of any Loan when and as the same shall become due and payable ...”
